v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You know someone else will integrate it."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Then we keep critical control details restricted."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The word carried his entire worldview.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Vance brought up a second map.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The expertise needed to reconstruct parts of G-DCL already existed across the world.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No one had all of it.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You are not deciding whether miniaturization happens."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You are deciding whether the international program is first."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If we don't do it," Vance continued, "someone with weaker safety architecture may."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "That's an argument everyone uses to justify going faster."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You can make the safest implementation the easiest one to copy."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "What if we define a modular program with no high-amplitude directional mode?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Design hardware that is good at bounded cancellation and bad at directed amplification."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Now it was an engineering problem.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Could actuator geometry make certain harmful modes expensive?
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Could local controllers enforce symmetric limits?
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Could a protection device embody a bias toward stabilization?
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Main bias unable to support rapid directional switching."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The conversation continued for two hours.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: By the end, they approved no portable system.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Only a study of components and safety-constrained architectures.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No directional amplification experiments above existing low-level commissioning limits.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The program would study how to make the machine smaller without making its worst behaviors easier.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian knew that sentence contained optimism.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: It was better than pretending miniaturization would wait for permission.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Do you think we can control who builds it?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "What if someone uses it to make a boundary around a military site?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "What if they build a field that rotates local support instead of stabilizing it?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You are asking the same question with different nouns."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "How do I make sure nothing important happens outside my control?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You used to want enough knowledge that no one could rewrite the answer."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Now you want enough control that no one can misuse the answer."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Keep the things we are tempted to hide because they're embarrassing."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "And don't confuse being the person who understands the model with being the person who should own the boundary."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: At 18:12, the building was mostly empty.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The pages from the last days spread backward.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He turned to a clean page.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: CONTROL REQUIRES A DEFINITION OF ACCEPTABLE STATES.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A protection system must decide what it preserves.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A distributed system must decide what each node may refuse.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: An institution must decide who may command, veto, observe, and audit.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A boundary is not only geometry. It is a decision.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Inside the building, floor and down had separated.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The structure survived because neighboring pieces of matter did not all experience the same relationship in the same way.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Water had risen because the familiar relationship between pressure, propagation, and support had come apart.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Every event had separated things civilization assumed belonged together.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Now G-DCL had done something similar intentionally.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Those were not properties waiting in nature.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: That was becoming more worrying than the laptop.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Do you know why investors like control?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He looked toward the underground levels.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If no one knows who can act, everyone prices the worst case."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Once someone owns the response, risk becomes a contract."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Someone will eventually ask whether one city gets a boundary before another."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "How many Geneva-class systems can you build in five years?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Every boundary you build somewhere is a boundary you did not build somewhere else."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "But the first generation will be scarce."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "I want you to understand the problem before you try to solve it with access control."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If you lock the technology down, the people with the strongest states get it first."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If you open it, anyone can weaponize it."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If we commercialize it, wealth determines access."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If international organizations allocate it, politics determines access."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Yesterday you created scarcity around a physical law."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You created access to altering its effect."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Once a physical phenomenon has an actuator, it has a politics."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You keep asking how to prevent someone else from controlling it."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "That's how people decide they're the exception."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He disliked Vance most when Vance was useful.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: At 20:03, Ian descended one last time to the G-DCL overlook.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The machine had returned to being absurdly large infrastructure around a room where nothing unusual was happening.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He looked at the twelve node positions.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He thought of the first Geneva event.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: One local FPGA acting when the center failed.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The technology had grown in scale because the problem had grown in scale.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Now the next breakthrough would probably reverse that.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The machine's physical cost would fall.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The problem is who you mean by we.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian did not like questions without a mathematical resolution.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: This one might never have one.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: An anomalous event can be detected before macroscopic consequence under at least some measured conditions.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A prospective model can make falsifiable predictions. One Geneva timing prediction failed. A second branch prediction succeeded within its frozen window.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Human intervention can causally modify local measured responses during an ongoing anomalous event.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Distributed local execution maintained a bounded internal region during severe external orientation deviation and one actuator-node loss.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No universal cancellation law has been demonstrated.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Before Geneva, the anomaly was a fact about nature.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Now control is a fact about us.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Far below him, pumps moved helium through eleven healthy nodes and one isolated system under repair.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The architecture had survived because control was incomplete.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: What he did not yet know was whether he could accept the same principle outside the machine.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Another person could choose a different target state.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Not because he believed he knew everything.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Because for the first time, he knew enough to understand how dangerous control might become in someone else's hands.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Through the glass, the twelve-node lattice remained still.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: It could not choose what counted as protection.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: It could not choose who deserved the safer side of a boundary.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: It could not choose when an acceptable correction became a weapon.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Those decisions existed outside the equations.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: And the equations would obey whoever supplied the target.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian stood there for a long time.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The first problem had been whether the anomaly was real.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The second had been whether it could be changed.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Someone would have to decide what reality was allowed to become.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

acts.title: EPILOGUE: THE OWNER OF THE BOUNDARY

v_en.content: Three months after Geneva, gravity had become boring again.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Rain fell vertically against the windows of the café.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Coffee remained at the bottom of cups.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A child's red balloon, tied to the back of a chair, pulled upward for reasons no one in the room considered remarkable.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Across the lake, a passenger aircraft descended toward Geneva Airport along a smooth conventional trajectory.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian Yoo watched it until the landing gear disappeared behind the buildings.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No disagreement between where the aircraft was and where its clocks believed it to be.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He had forgotten how strange that looked.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Two people arguing in French over a laptop.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A woman balancing three glasses on one hand.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No one tested the floor before stepping onto it.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No one checked whether the surface of their drink agreed with the building's structural frame.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The world had resumed spending certainty it had never actually possessed.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: You could not measure local vertical before every step.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: You could not verify spatial connectivity before crossing a doorway.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: You could not compare four clocks before boarding an aircraft.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: At some point, physical regularity had to become habit.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: That did not make it fundamental.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He was twelve minutes early himself.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Geneva had not experienced another anomalous event.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The Pacific monitoring network had recorded several acoustic disturbances, all eventually attributable to ordinary causes.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Flight 702 had returned to service after months of inspection, software review, structural examination, and argument.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The aircraft had not teleported again.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No other aircraft had reproduced its event.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: That absence had become evidence of nothing.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The inward-moving model survived some new data and failed to sharpen under others.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No front was observed approaching Earth.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Instead, it had started ordering equipment.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Major airports now preserved physically impossible GNSS updates instead of reducing them immediately to navigation faults.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Several high-rise regulators had issued interim guidance on multidirectional restraint and independent inertial sensing.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Deep-ocean observatories were adding raw timing channels to acoustic networks.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: National metrology institutes had discovered that everyone suddenly wanted portable optical clocks.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Superconducting-conductor qualification slots that had once attracted niche interest now had waiting lists.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Three independent laboratories had received approval to replicate portions of the Denver effect.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: None had yet reproduced the full macroscopic support result.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The Netherlands optical team had strengthened its propagation finding.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A Japanese group had reported a compatible low-amplitude phase response, then withdrawn part of its initial analysis after discovering a thermal cross-coupling term.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Sterling had called that good science.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The press had called it confusion.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: There was still only one Geneva Distributed Cancellation Lattice.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Eleven currently qualified for full operation.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Node Four had returned from repair eighteen days earlier but remained under restricted envelope pending repeated thermal cycling.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A field-control technology that required a facility the size of a research campus was difficult to steal in a briefcase.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The meeting was in a private room on the third floor of a building owned by one of Vance's holding companies, far enough from CERN to avoid institutional symbolism and close enough that everyone could pretend the location had been chosen for convenience.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Vance stood beside a wall display.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Colored points covered North America, Europe, East Asia, India, and several other locations.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Exactly as if that answered everything.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian looked at the map again.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: There were more points than he expected.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Companies asking companies whether certain things can be manufactured."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "I didn't ask whether it was legal."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Don't assume every point is a field program."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The system connected them with a dotted line.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Vance sighed and opened the legend.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: One defense laboratory with a broad advanced-field-control solicitation.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: One aerospace contractor studying distributed timing and superconducting pulsed systems.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: One classified-looking gap where procurement data simply disappeared.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: No one had a Geneva-class system.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "They don't have the full control basis."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "They don't have our state-dependent kernel adaptation."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Vance looked back at the map.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Vance enlarged a group of facilities.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Together they possessed most of its industrial vocabulary.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "They don't need your equations forever, Ian."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "The first machine belongs to the people who understand the effect."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "The second belongs to the people who learn how to manufacture it."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "The third belongs to whoever can deploy it."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "A number would make you think time is the only variable."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "And whether someone decides they don't need to reproduce Geneva."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "We don't need parallel miniaturization this early."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Slowing your program does not slow everyone else's."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Some not even known to be related.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Enough to make the uncertainty real.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Then the international framework needs stronger restrictions."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Sarah leaned back against the table.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Then condition access to the Geneva data."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Independent high-amplitude replication should require joint inspection."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "What exactly are you trying to control?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Vance turned away from the screen.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Then why are you looking at me like that?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Because responsibility and ownership start sounding similar when the person responsible decides no one else can be trusted."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You saw what one wrong phase reference did."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You saw what centralized control almost did."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You saw what happens if someone chooses the wrong target state."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Then someone has to make sure they don't."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: That had been easier than expected.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Sarah pushed away from the table.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You keep talking about who gets to operate the field."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: She pointed toward the Geneva marker on the map.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "A boundary is not just a field solution."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian remembered writing almost the same thing.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: She could not have seen the notebook.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "And when the two cannot both be protected?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian looked back at the map.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Potential machines that did not yet exist.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: That was not the same as accepting the conclusion.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Whether the rules exist to make sure no one owns the boundary."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Or to make sure the right people do."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He turned off the procurement layer.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Only confirmed and probable programs remained.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "The technology isn't dangerous because one person can own it today."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "It's dangerous because eventually several people can."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Then the safest architecture has to become the standard first."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian looked at the blank display.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If other programs build without these safeguards?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Then why are you comfortable with it?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "I just don't think discomfort gives us jurisdiction over everyone else."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If they build a mobile directional field—"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "If they put a boundary around something we need to observe?"
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Then we learn what we can still observe."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You learned to say I don't know."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "That saying it isn't the end of the lesson."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Sometimes the next sentence is and someone else gets to decide."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "We have events across three continents and an ocean."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "You cannot solve every dangerous uncertainty by moving the decision closer to yourself."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: She looked at him for another second.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "The programs on that map don't need to be malicious."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "City B has the only manufacturing plant for critical node hardware."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Site C is a military early-warning network."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: "Allocation problems always are until they aren't."
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Ian remained in the room for another twenty minutes.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: For how long, he did not know.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Are you still in Geneva next week?
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Good. I found something of yours while moving boxes.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A small drafting compass lay on an old dining table.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He had believed it was still in storage in London.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: You told me years ago it was useless.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Six days later, rain came to Geneva.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: It fell from low gray clouds and struck the lake in thousands of small impacts that no monitoring network classified as significant.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Seo-yeon had sent the compass by insured courier after refusing to trust Ian with remembering to collect it.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The case sat in his coat pocket.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He walked alone along the lake after sunset.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: For once, no one needed anything from him.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: The city lights stretched across wet pavement.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Its position followed a continuous path.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: He had spent years trying to find variables institutions could not rewrite.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Now he understood the darker version of that ambition.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: A physical law did not need to lie to become political.
v_en.author: Kwang Yong Yoo

v_en.content: Whoever chose the center chose the boundary.
